title: Add listenWhen for markPresence snackbar transitions
objective: Guard MeetingDetailsScreen BlocConsumer listener so markPresence success/error snackbars fire once per status transition instead of replaying on follow-up state emissions.
acceptance_criteria: MeetingDetailsScreen BlocConsumer includes listenWhen or equivalent transition gating
markPresence success snackbar fires exactly once per successful mark action
markPresence error snackbar fires exactly once per failed mark action
deleteMeeting navigation and snackbar side effects remain transition-gated and do not replay
Existing listener body behavior is preserved except for duplicate replay prevention
flutter analyze for meeting details feature reports no new errors
